content.text:
I submitted **index 10** (Ag 0.4845 / V 0.5155), the best of the three compositions I could measure: its photocurrent was 2.4e-7 A. Most of the library went unmeasured, so a better composition may still exist.

| Index | Ag fraction | Photocurrent (A) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0.4845 | **2.4e-7** |
| 12 | 0.7453 | 3e-8 |
| 5 | 0.525 | -8e-8 |

- **Index 10:** it is the most V-rich composition in the library, close to AgVO3. The models support that phase: MACE puts it on the hull, and MEGNet predicts a band gap of about 2.9 eV, low enough to absorb the 3.22 eV light.
- **Index 12:** I measured this first because it sits at the Ag3VO4 composition, a known photoanode phase. It gave the second-best result. MEGNet predicted a near-zero gap for Ag3VO4, which disagrees with the known value of about 2.2 eV, so I didn't rely on it.
- **Index 5:** this is a surprise, since it is next to index 10 and even closer to AgVO3's exact composition. Its XRD showed only substrate peaks, so the film may not have crystallized.

XRD was of little use overall. Both scans (indices 12 and 5) were dominated by substrate peaks, so I couldn't confirm which phase each film contains.

Index 11 (Ag 0.576) was the model's next suggestion, but I had used up all three measurements by then. Its predicted value was below index 10's.
